content:
A batch review can produce separate MARKET_B and SERVICE source lots plus a delayed held lot. Their exact IDs, classifications and free balances are outputs of review.

The first release amount is a cash total, not a promise that every released dollar can be converted. The later batch_release removes the held portion from the batch original lot_ids without altering source classifications.
